model: Insurer FCFE at cost of equity on core revenue, capital retention to hold book/revenue (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 8.1% vs EPS 5yr 15.2% (>30% divergence): GAAP EPS includes equity mark-to-market (FY22 -$3.06, FY21 $18.43), so EPS CAGRs are endpoint noise. Equity 3yr 14.6% starts from the FY2022 bear-market trough. Reported revenue 3yr 24.4% is the same distortion; core revenue (premiums + NII) 10.9-11.7% is the operating anchor.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are OCF-capex less SBC ($31-46m) and describe float growth, not distributable cash -- not used. EPS 3yr CAGR undefined (FY2022 loss). Premium growth has run 8-11%/yr in a hard market; guidance for FY2026 is mid-single-digit NWP growth, two-thirds rate.

scenario_narratives.base: Commercial-lines pricing moderates from the post-2022 highs and core revenue growth slows from ~11% to mid-single digits, but underwriting holds near the long-run ~95% combined ratio as California homeowners terms are tightened and E&S/Cincinnati Re keep growing. The ~$13bn equity portfolio earns a normal ~5% price return on top of dividends. That compounds book at ~6-7% plus a ~3.5% dividend yield on book, an ROE of ~10.7% against a 9% cost of equity: worth ~1.3x book, a little under today's 1.5x.
scenario_narratives.bull: E&S (+8%) and Cincinnati Re (+16%, 87.6% combined) keep taking share, the commercial-lines cat problem of 2025-26 proves cyclical rather than a risk-selection failure, and the combined ratio settles at ~92-93%. Equity markets deliver ~6%/yr price appreciation on the outsized portfolio. ROE returns to the ~13% of the last decade and the market keeps paying ~1.7x book for a Dividend King compounding at 7%+.
scenario_narratives.bear: The P&C cycle softens just as cat frequency and social inflation stay elevated: commercial lines stays above 100%, California and convective-storm losses recur, and adverse development appears in long-tail umbrella/workers' comp. An equity-market correction hits the ~40% equity allocation in FY27, marking book down. ROE falls to ~8.5%, below the cost of equity, and the stock de-rates towards ~0.9x book -- the dividend streak survives but per-share value compounds slowly.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A P&C insurer is worth the book it compounds, not its cash flow statement. Operating cash flow is float growth and GAAP net income swings with the equity portfolio's mark-to-market, so the model values normalised earnings (underwriting + investment income + an expected, not realised, equity return) net of the equity retention needed to grow premiums with a constant book/revenue ratio, discounted at the cost of equity with debt serviced inside the flow. The result is equivalent to a terminal P/B of (ROE-g)/(CoE-g): base ~1.3x on ~10.7% ROE.
key_risks_to_valuation: Equity market: $13.2bn equity securities (~0.8x book, $8.9bn unrealised gain) -- a 20% drawdown takes ~$2.1bn after tax (~$13.5/share) off book at once
Catastrophe and California wildfire exposure; commercial lines combined 104.1% in Q2-26
Reserve adequacy in long-tail commercial casualty under social inflation
Soft-market transition compressing both premium growth and margins together
The expected equity-appreciation assumption (5% base) is the single largest judgment: each 1pp is ~1.1pp of margin and roughly $10-12/share

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 150.00-194.81
data_sources.financials: CINF_Metrics.csv / CINF.duckdb (SEC XBRL) plus SEC companyfacts API (CIK 0000020286) for PremiumsEarnedNet, NetInvestmentIncome, RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses, pre-tax income, tax, equity securities at fair value, share counts, SBC, dividends and buybacks paid
data_sources.qualitative: CINF_Analysis.json (2026-09-26): Q2-2026 results and call, guidance, bull/bear cases

inputs.share_count_basis: 153.478m shares on issue at 2026-07-22 (10-Q cover) + ~1.6m dilutive awards (Q2-2026 diluted 155.7m less basic 154.1m weighted) = 155.1m fully diluted; held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows and buybacks (FY25 $205m, H1-26 $395m) fund the flat count
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 10-K XBRL: AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpenseNetOfTax $37m + tax benefit $9m = $46m pre-tax (0.41% of core revenue). No separate net-share-settlement withholding line disclosed.
inputs.book_value_anchor: Shareholders' equity $16,671m at 2026-06-30 (BVPS $108.64 per company); price/book 1.50x. Equity securities at fair value $13,194m (cost $4,287m), fixed maturities $18,954m.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of equity, not WACC: the stream is after holding-company interest (~$53m/yr on $790m senior notes) so it is discounted at CoE and no debt is deducted. USD build: 10y UST ~4.3% + beta ~0.8 x 5.0% ERP = 8.3%, lifted to 9.0% for catastrophe volatility and the equity portfolio (~0.8x book) that levers book value to the stock market. Same 9.0% in all three scenarios (risk charged once, in the scenario paths).
inputs.lease_treatment: Immaterial for an insurer; no lease line modelled.
inputs.notes: MODEL: routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md -- insurer row (BVPS compounding x exit P/B). Implemented through the engine as FCFE at cost of equity, the same family IAG.AX used, because it is arithmetically the BVPS-compounding model (terminal P/B = (ROE-g)/(CoE-g)) and keeps the dashboard sliders live. Mapping of engine fields: revenue = CORE revenue (net earned premiums + net investment income + other; FY2025 $9,983m + $1,165m + $41m = $11,189m), i.e. reported revenue $12,631m less realized/fair-value investment gains $1,442m. 'EBITDA margin' = normalised pre-tax, pre-SBC earnings / core revenue = underwriting + investment income + an EXPECTED equity-portfolio price appreciation (base 5%/yr on ~$13.2bn = ~5.5% of revenue) in place of the reported mark-to-market gains; D&A and capex are 0; cash tax = GAAP effective rate (~19.5%, muni and dividends-received shelter; FY23-25 19.0-19.8%). 'Working capital' = required equity retention: wc_capture -140% of the revenue increase holds book/core revenue at ~1.40x (June-26 book $16,671m / FY26E core revenue ~$11.9bn), so FCFE = net income - book growth needed to write the premium. NET DEBT HELD AT ZERO: the $790m senior notes (plus $69m short-term; total_debt $859m) are serviced inside the flow, and cash is float/investment inventory, not surplus. Reported FCF ($3,092m OCF-capex) is float growth, not owner cash, and is recorded for audit only. last_fcf = FY2025 cash actually distributed (dividends $525m + buybacks $205m = $730m). Year 1 is FY2026, ~9 months elapsed at the valuation date; H1-26 book and Q2 cat losses are reflected in the FY26 margin. Operating pre-tax (pre-tax less investment gains): FY21 $1,289m (17.9% of core rev), FY22 $773m (9.6%), FY23 $1,149m (12.9%), FY24 $1,467m (14.7%), FY25 $1,538m (13.7%, LA wildfires).

bear.margin_rationale: Soft market plus persistent cat/social-inflation drag: combined ratio ~98-99% -> operating ~10.5%; equity appreciation only 3%/yr (~3.3% of revenue); FY27 carries an equity-market drawdown. ROE ~8.5%, below CoE, so book trades below 1x.

base.margin_rationale: Normalised operating pre-tax ~13.5% of core revenue (FY21-25 average 13.8%, ~95% P&C combined ratio) plus 5% expected price appreciation on the ~$13.2bn equity book (~5.3% of revenue) plus SBC add-back 0.4pp. FY26 held ~1pp lower for the Q2 cat quarter (100.8% combined, commercial 104.1%). Implies ROE ~10.7% on book.
base.growth_rationale: FY26 mid-single-digit NWP growth per Q2-26 call, with earned premium lagging written and NII still rising on reinvestment yields; decelerating to nominal-GDP 3% as commercial pricing moderates.

bull.margin_rationale: Combined ratio ~92-93% (E&S and Cincinnati Re mix shift, California repricing done) -> operating ~16%, plus 6% equity appreciation (~6.3% of revenue). ROE ~13%, in line with the 2016-2025 record.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 20x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default): the pricing cycle is turning, Q2-26 commercial combined ratio was 104%, and book is levered ~0.8x to equity markets near highs. Base 50%. Bull 30% (below 35%): it needs benign cats, sustained E&S/Re growth AND a continued equity bull market at once, though CINF's 65-year dividend record and conservative reserving make it a credible path rather than a stretch.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
